defects.description: Instructions say sit fully back into the chair, letting the backrest support the spine (upright or slight back-arch). Derived torso flexion is +18 deg (forward lean) — opposite of backrest-supported upright posture. PR-v4 prior auto-fix increased spine 8 to 18 for visibility but went the WRONG direction (forward lean).

regression_risk: low - single-pose config correction. Head pitch shifts ~27 deg but stays in natural range. No other joints changed.
rationale: Per FK convention spine + = forward lean, - = backward arch. Description backrest-supported spine = upright or slight back arch. PR-v4 auto-fix went wrong direction (8 to 18 forward). Propose spine: -5 (slight visible back arch reads as backrest-supported, chest open, shoulders relaxed). This is the smallest valid sign-correcting change. Head pitch (currently +18, derived from spine + neck -4.4) becomes ~-9 (slight upward, natural relaxed gaze).
